        From 1d174e95176dfe5bdcec78f2d5b9440dd79798c3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wei Yongjun <weiyongjun1@huawei.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jan 2018 02:14:33 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] cxgb4: make symbol pedits static

Fixes the following sparse warning:

drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_tc_flower.c:46:27: warning:
 symbol 'pedits' was not declared. Should it be static?

Fixes: 27ece1f357b7 ("cxgb4: add tc flower support for ETH-DMAC rewrite")
Signed-off-by: Wei Yongjun <weiyongjun1@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>
---
 drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_tc_flower.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_tc_flower.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_tc_flower.c
index 4fee3553e1a3..36563364bae7 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_tc_flower.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_tc_flower.c
@@ -43,7 +43,7 @@
 
 #define STATS_CHECK_PERIOD (HZ / 2)
 
-struct ch_tc_pedit_fields pedits[] = {
+static struct ch_tc_pedit_fields pedits[] = {
 	PEDIT_FIELDS(ETH_, DMAC_31_0, 4, dmac, 0),
 	PEDIT_FIELDS(ETH_, DMAC_47_32, 2, dmac, 4),
 	PEDIT_FIELDS(ETH_, SMAC_15_0, 2, smac, 0),
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The symbol 'pedits' was not declared as static, which led to a sparse warning indicating that it should be static. This suggests that 'pedits' was intended to have internal linkage, meaning it should only be accessible within the file it is defined in, to avoid potential naming conflicts with other files. The lack of the static keyword could lead to unintended behavior if other parts of the codebase inadvertently reference the same symbol name.

Root cause:
The symbol 'pedits' was not declared as static, which led to a sparse warning indicating that it should be static. This suggests that 'pedits' was intended to have internal linkage, meaning it should only be accessible within the file it is defined in, to avoid potential naming conflicts with other files. The lack of the static keyword could lead to unintended behavior if other parts of the codebase inadvertently reference the same symbol name.
